checks.name: Indicator finite-input probe
checks.details: SMA/EMA rejected or safely handled all non-finite probes.

checks.name: Provider isolation (static heuristic)
checks.details: Provider filter and memory-key references found.

checks.name: Secret hygiene (static scan)
checks.details: No high-confidence hard-coded secrets found; per-worker hash/expiry/RLS controls detected. .env files were not read; this is not a full secret scanner.

checks.name: Security Core controls (static check)
checks.details: Verified admin metadata, mutation auditing, expiring worker tokens, browser-only public Auth, safe worker errors, and loopback Compose binding.

checks.name: Staging isolation (static configuration)
checks.details: No host ports, internal-only network, dedicated storage, private settings and no Supabase target are configured; runtime connectivity is checked separately.

checks.name: Monitoring history RLS (static check)
checks.details: RLS remains enabled and table privileges are limited to the service role.

checks.name: Diagnostic history RLS (static check)
checks.details: Incident history uses unique fingerprints, deduplicated observations, enabled RLS, and server-role-only access.

checks.name: Central event log RLS/privacy (static check)
checks.details: Events have unique/correlation IDs, configurable retention, sensitive-key filtering, RLS, and service-role-only storage.

checks.name: Task scheduler RLS/deduplication (static check)
checks.details: Schedules use RLS/service-role grants, unique execution slots, bounded ownership, priority claims, and safe cancellation.

checks.name: Worker load balancing/RPC access (static check)
checks.details: Claims use fresh resource/heartbeat observations, task history, one-job capacity, row locking, and service-role-only RPC access.

checks.name: Expired worker lease recovery/access (static check)
checks.details: Recovery is bounded/idempotent, uses row locking and retry backoff, and exposes its RPC only to service_role.

checks.name: Hybrid signal history RLS/deduplication (static check)
checks.details: Point-in-time signals use unique timestamps, completed-outcome updates, RLS, and service-role-only storage.

score.note: This is an automated-check pass rate, not a certification or the weighted expert score from the manual audit.

scope: Local static checks and tests only; no live trading, broker, or production database actions.
